name: Cheque 20
definition: Characteristics of a cheque instruction, such as cheque type or cheque number.

InstructionIdentification.name: Instruction Identification
InstructionIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by an instructing party for an instructed party, to unambiguously identify the instruction. ||Usage: The instruction identification is a point to point reference that can be used between the instructing party and the instructed party to refer to the individual instruction. It can be included in several messages related to the instruction.

OriginalInstructionIdentification.name: Original Instruction Identification
OriginalInstructionIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original instructing party for the original instructed party, to unambiguously identify the original instruction.

ChequeNumber.name: Cheque Number
ChequeNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a cheque as assigned by the agent.

IssueDate.name: Issue Date
IssueDate.definition: Date when the cheque has been issued by the payer.

StaleDate.name: Stale Date
StaleDate.definition: Date after which a cheque is no longer valid.|Usage:|The validity period of a cheque is calculated from the issue date on the face of the cheque.|The period may be indicated on the face of the cheque itself such as "Valid for 90 days” or may be determined in accordance with domestic banking practice. |Not all countries will have a validity period.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Specifies the amount of the cheque to be paid to the payee.

EffectiveDate.name: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.definition: Date and time at which the cheque amount becomes available on the payee account.

DrawerAgent.name: Drawer Agent
DrawerAgent.definition: Specifies the agent servicing the account of the cheque payer.

DrawerAgentAccount.name: Drawer Agent Account
DrawerAgentAccount.definition: Specifies the cash account of the drawer agent.

Payee.name: Payee
Payee.definition: Party that receives an amount of money as specified in the cheque.

PayeeAccount.name: Payee Account
PayeeAccount.definition: Specifies the cash account of the payee.

ChequeCancellationOrStopReason.name: Cheque Cancellation Or Stop Reason
ChequeCancellationOrStopReason.definition: Specifies the reason for stopping the payment of the cheque or a request for reimbursement authorisation.
